target: dola_protocol buyDBR -> Curve TriDBR pool arb
why: Keeper EOA 0xadc26ec3d7fdcc3332e67fd74cb8df7f475a3706 (through its own router 0x126354ea9bba320c56e4fb9441509cc44e79c9f8) takes Dola DBR at the protocol price and sells it into the Curve TriDBR pool in the same transaction; it is paid by the spread, not by a fee schedule. Measured 24 h: 35 txs (nonce 25930@26424517 -> 25965@26431717). Sample of 20 of ~35 txs (blocks 26426840-26431441, hashes 0xbf17d68d..., 0x1113bce4..., 0x15e2f4aa...): median +$0.131 per call, mean +$0.67 (one +$10.92 fill: 25 sDOLA -> 854.24 DBR -> 35.919 DOLA = +43%), sum +$13.44 over 17.8 h => ~$23.5 gross/day, ~$5/day if that one outsized fill is excluded. Gas 229k-330k gas at 0.12-0.20 gwei = $0.051-$0.156, mean $0.086 => ~$3.0/day; net ~$20/day (or ~$2/day without the outlier).
next_steps: Venues: Auction 0x933cbe81313d9dd523df6dc9b899a7af8ba073e3 buyDBR(uint256,uint256,address) 0xb23adea6 (verified Auction.sol, no access control), sDOLA buffer 0xb45ad160634c528cc3d2926d9807104fa3157305 same selector, inverse auction 0x6f80a22a57c7f0257094ea8d426af3f747defbc7 0x3510a890 (paid in sDOLA, gave the +43% fill), a USDC venue 0x7cac7f...; sell leg Curve pool 0x66da369fc5dbba0774da70546bd20f2b242cd34d (DOLA/DBR/USDC tricrypto, function 0x29b244bb, TokenExchange 0x143f1f8e...). Others take it too: ledger source inverse_dbr_auction.buy shows 498 buys by 31 addresses in blocks 26373945-26408261, our actor only 387 - so the venue is not role-gated, but the actor wins ~78% of it and the typical remaining spread ($0.01-$0.37 on 200-350k gas) is thin: this is a size-and-patience arb (a fresh address is paid the same spread, but the fill must be big enough to clear $0.09 gas; the sDOLA leg is where the fat fills were). Count measured over 24 h only; a builder should re-measure the 7-day count and the fill-size distribution before building.
